text:
[IDSP.7.10] A conforming implementation must exercise the engine-owned-cache
contract: a volatile-cache round-trip (set, then `cached()` returns the
JSON-text with **no** callback wired); a miss returning FALSE
distinguishably from a hit; the optional persistence callbacks invoked on
set / delete when wired and skipped without error when NULL;
`ACTION_CACHE_SET` / `_DELETE` firing on the engine write while
`ACTION_CACHE_GET` is not emitted; per-verb arity / type rejection; negative
ttl and bad JSON rejected; and a wired persistence callback's error
propagating without rolling back the engine cache.
